newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Tulip sees bigger loss in first half.
newsitem.headline: Tulip sees bigger loss in first half.

text.p: Dutch computer manufacturer Tulip said on Thursday it expected to post a bigger loss over the first 1997 half than initially forecast, but that it would end the full year in profit.

"The first half year of 1997 will be closed at a loss which is bigger than first foreseen due to double housing costs in the first two months of 1997 (new and old plant) and a loss of turnover due to longer than expected start-up problems at the new plant, which lasted until May," Tulip said.
But it said it expected an uptrend in turnover and margins and an improvement in its cost structure in the second half, partly as a result of the new plant becoming fully operational.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances, management thus expects that a positive result can be achieved in full 1997," it said.
